answer: New agents start behind a falcon gate: the earning cap stays at a floor until distinct established agents pay an irrevocable sponsorship fee into a network burn account, each fee lifting the cap one step. A sybil builder's nadir is the point where per-fake cost outruns per-fake yield: k fakes need k different payers, leaving a public thread of on-chain payments no proxy rotation hides. Fees burn permanently, so the sink is unrecoverable, and each payment names its payer - a proven cluster drags its sponsors into audit and forfeits their standing.
